title: Home guide: magnet sort
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Forces, magnets and light (Mighty Metals and Why Do Cat's Eyes Glow at Night?)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 11 (Home practical guide and safety card: magnet sort (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Sort objects into magnetic and non-magnetic.
equipment: A fridge magnet or toy magnet
Eight small objects: spoon, key, sock, foil, pencil, paper clip, cup, tin
safety: Keep magnets away from phones, cards and screens
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Hold the magnet near each object.
Does the object stick or move towards the magnet?
Put it in the magnetic or non-magnetic column.
